text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy grounds...
A patch of ground unnaturally covered in fallen leaves
appeared right along my path.

Aaaah!?
Why are you avoiding my pitfall trap, nodaaaa~~!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This pitfall trap carries Windy-chan's
pride, which was insulted back then, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! No matter how many times I get scolded, I won't stop!
I'm gonna keep digging pitfall traps, noda!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah. You really never learn. Well, compared to Golshi's, this is cute!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She dug a flawless pitfall in the carrot patch and gave all the students who came for snacks a hard time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Compared to that, digging a hole so sloppy that even I can spot it means... you're strictly minor league!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngaaah! I'm definitely gonna make something way better than Golshi's and trouble tons of students, nodaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's digging this pitfall not for pranks,
but to repel snack-stealers.
...Though she hasn't realized that at all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, but why did you notice...?
I hid the hole perfectly with fallen leaves this time, noda!?
choice_data_list: Actually, that's what made it look unnatural.
Actually, that's what made it look unnatural.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...!
H-Hmph! Windy-chan thought so too, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You've got some decent eyes on you.
I'll make you my henchman, so help me out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I didn't have any urgent business, I decided
to go along with her work. However—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How's that! This time I scattered leaves naturally
around the outside of the hole too—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!? The wind blew them all away, nodaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I used rocks as weights, so they won't blow away now!
Next, if I pour water in as cushioning—
choice_data_list: Won't the water just soak into the dirt?
Won't the water just soak into the dirt?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Eh!? Why!?
It doesn't turn into a pool!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Laid down a tarp in the hole,
and added... water... *gasp*... Next, if I
step down like this—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—H-Huh!?
Now I'm not falling into the pitfall at all, noda!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah! I gotta redo it all over again, nodaaa~~!
I'm tired, I'm tired, I'm soo tired~~!!
choice_data_list: Let's take a break and try again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way! No matter how tough the prey is,
these fangs will never break!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That is Windy-chan's...
code of the hunter, noda!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her indomitable spirit is admirable.
However, I'm worried about her exhaustion.
What should I say to her here...?
choice_data_list: Leave the rest to your henchman.
Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut uuuup!
You're the henchman, so listen to your boss, noda!
choice_data_list: Letting the henchmen handle things is part of the boss's job too.
Letting the henchmen handle things is part of the boss's job too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mumu!? ...Now that you mention it, in that sentai show I watched,
the boss was always sitting solidly in a big chair, noda...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, deal! Work hard at it!
Your boss will be right here watching over you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Shinko Windy taking a rest,
work proceeded swiftly and efficiently—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, it's done! Looks great on the outside.
But the most important thing is whether it works properly—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
These footsteps... it must be the snack thief, noda!
Let's see how our pitfall performs right away!

Hm? She's not here either—
...Wait, GYAAAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, yahoo~~!! They fell for it, noda-!
Henchman! I praise you!
choice_data_list: More importantly, the person who fell in...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's right!
Let's check out our captured prey and savor the results, noda!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... I was worried I fired you up a bit too much, but you sure managed to dig a magnificent pitfall.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll have to... thoroughly, properly,
give you my 'thanks' for this, huh~~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the pitfall's quality was acknowledged,
poor Hishi Amazon ended up as an innocent casualty...
and Windy ended up getting a thorough scolding after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should respect her wishes.
If she looks like she's about to overexert herself,
I'll support her so she doesn't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All righty! That's what makes you
Windy-chan's recognized henchman, noda!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her instructions while offering
occasional advice, our work progressed—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's... DOOOOONE~~~!
Yahoo, yahoo! We actually pulled it off, noda-!
Hahaha! How was it? Did you get a different sense of accomplishment than with your usual pranks?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama! ...Yeah, totally different, noda!
Because I thought hard about how to catch lots of prey, worked creatively, and tried my best...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The quality of my mischief leveled up a whole bunch, noda!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh, the quality of your mis—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's not it at all!? Even if it's still a pitfall, it's for preventing snack theft... it became a helpful prank, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't you feel something about that!? Like making pranks useful to people... or something!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
? What are you talking about, noda?
Pranks have nothing to do with helping people, noda!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through and through, Shinko Windy remained
an unrepentant little troublemaker.
